content:
Claude is upgrading its Chrome sidebar into a full Cowork session, allowing tasks and conversations in the browser to follow users seamlessly across Claude's other apps.

Claude can now take browser tasks to all apps

Anthropic announced the change today. Conversations started in the sidebar will now be saved to Claude's history and can be picked up from the Claude desktop, web and mobile apps.

Skills and connectors that are already set up on the account can now be used directly in the browser with no extra configuration. Claude in Chrome can see the current page and use the user's existing browser logins to operate, including clicking links, switching pages, typing text and filling in forms.

Anthropic's example is to ask Claude to gather invoice data from several vendor websites, compile a spreadsheet, and then continue the same session on the desktop to add local files or compare with older budgets.

This update fills a gap in Claude's browser workflow. Previously, sidebar sessions and conversations in Claude's other apps were kept separate, and the conversation content and context would stay behind and couldn't be brought along.

Anthropic previously pointed out in particular that the browser built into Claude Code uses an independent profile; by contrast, the Chrome extension works directly using sites the user is already logged into.

Anthropic warns that browser agents are still vulnerable to prompt injection attacks.

There is also a separate review mechanism that examines impactful actions when automatic approval is enabled, and for actions involving purchases or sharing personal data, Claude will still ask for the user's consent first.

The company says these safeguards reduce risk but do not eliminate it entirely.

Availability

The Cowork sidebar is rolling out to Max and Team customers today, and Pro subscribers will get it over the coming weeks. Enterprise admins can enable the feature themselves, and can also restrict access to an approved list of domains. Claude in Chrome is not yet supported on other Chromium browsers or on mobile.

This update continues Anthropic's strategy of making Claude work seamlessly across platforms.

Recent additions include live iOS app testing in Claude Code on Mac, and new Opus 4.8 controls for long-running work on more products and devices.
